title: Chapter 472
text:
The two of them fought passionately, and the mercenaries in the monitoring room were dumbfounded.

Black Star was actually able to fight evenly with a Calamity Grade Super?

The first thought that came to their minds was that their opponent might not be as strong as he looked. Although they had never seen the strength of a Calamity Grade Super before, they had heard too many rumors about how terrifying a Calamity Grade Super was and how they could kill a Grade B Super effortlessly.

However, after seeing the battle between Han Xiao and Ashes, perhaps the strength of a Calamity Grade Super was not as exaggerated as the rumors said?

This group of mercenaries gained a little confidence.

"I'm going down to help." A mercenary with a big beard suddenly stood up and took out his gun.

The others were shocked. Although the enemy was not as strong as they had imagined, it was better to stay here quietly. Why did they have to take the risk?

The bearded mercenary looked at the others with disdain. He felt that this was an opportunity.

Since it was not that dangerous, going down to help would be a good opportunity to perform in front of Black Star and leave a deep impression. He was a solo mercenary, and he might even have the chance to be recruited into the Black Star Mercenary.

This person hurriedly left the monitoring room. The others did not dare follow him and could only look at the monitoring screen.

The bearded mercenary rushed to the battlefield. The commotion caused by the battle made him nervous and regretful. He took a deep breath and told himself that he would seek riches in danger.

Following which, he barged through the door with a bang, raised his gun, and fired at Ashes's back. He purposely shouted, "Black Star, I'm here to support you! Quick … "

Pa!

In the blink of an eye, before the bearded mercenary could finish his words, his body 'collapsed', and dust leaked out from his clothes.

"He … he died just like that?"

The eyes of the mercenaries in the monitoring room were wide open, and fear appeared on their faces.

Not strong my ass!

That was so scary!

A Calamity Grade Super is too scary. We should just hide here and watch the show!

The courage that this group of mercenaries had just sprouted was immediately thrown out of the window, and they were instantly terrified.

Only then did the few of them understand that Black Star, who was able to fight a Calamity Grade Super, was not as weak as the other mercenaries had privately discussed. It was likely that the group of Grade B mercenaries who secretly thought highly of themselves and looked down on Black Star would not be able to beat Black Star even if they worked together.

Sure enough, his reputation was well-deserved.

…

On the battlefield, Han Xiao was puzzled. Why didn't this bearded mercenary hide properly? Did Aesop possess him and deliberately run down to seek death?

At this time, Ashes used the same trick again, wanting to paralyze these machines again. He did not believe that Han Xiao could continuously restore the machines.

His guess was right. Han Xiao indeed could not use [Waste Modification] indefinitely. Other than the number of times it could be used, it also consumed a lot of energy.

However, Han Xiao knew that these carbon particles were as important to Ashes as machines were to him. Without them, his combat power would be greatly reduced.

For this, Han Xiao had already made preparations.

With a snap of his fingers, the trap machine that had not been activated lit up.

In the black tide, spherical light shields appeared one after another, capturing the carbon particles. The black cloud instantly became much thinner.

These machines were not anything special but very ordinary shield generators. They were not traps in the traditional sense. However, in Han Xiao's eyes, all machines could be traps. These shields covered a large number of carbon particles, which was equivalent to trapping them, turning them into a reverse prison.

Even though Ashes could still control these carbon particles, he had to break the shields, which was a waste of time. Not only that, it also distracted him.

This move instantly weakened Ashes' actual combat power!

The material of this stronghold was alloys that did not contain carbon, and Han Xiao's machines did not use carbon steel. Other than the mercenaries who had just come down to deliver their heads, Ashes did not have anywhere to replenish the carbon particles. The range of his Esper ability was not small, but even if he could extract carbon from outside the stronghold, it would take time unless he extracted his own carbon.

The remaining carbon particles suddenly revolved around Ashes, turning into a cutting tornado that wanted to drill through the ceiling. Ashes had already realized that this terrain was very disadvantageous to him. He wanted to change the battlefield so that he could unleash several times his current combat power in the outside world.

However, Ashes did not realize that his attitude toward Han Xiao had changed. From the initial contempt to now, he even began to seriously consider the influence of the terrain on the battle. He felt pressure from Han Xiao, a grade B Super, and saw him as an opponent that could threaten him!

At this time, Han Xiao did not retreat. Instead, he charged toward the dangerous cutting tornado and shouted.

"Explode!"

Boom!

The mercenaries in the monitoring room hurriedly detonated the bomb. The stronghold collapsed, and countless steel fragments fell.

Han Xiao respected Calamity Grade Supers very much, so the explosives he buried were especially heavy. Explosions were art. The entire building where the stronghold was located began to collapse. The floor fell, and the two of them entered a state of weightlessness.

Rumble!

The surroundings were filled with falling debris, and the choking smoke covered their vision. It was as if the earth was shaking.

Ashes hurriedly formed a diamond board under his feet to balance himself. He wanted to fly out of the collapsed building and use the remaining carbon particles to destroy the falling debris.

Hu!

The dust in the distance whistled. After fighting for so long, Ashes had already recognized that this was the sound of the High Frequency Strike Cannon. He knew that Han Xiao was chasing after him like a mad dog. Even if he did not want to fight in the complicated falling environment, Ashes had no choice but to respond.

Suddenly, a black shadow appeared in front of his eyes, blocking his vision.

Ashes was shocked. He could not see anything. No matter what he did, he could not get rid of the shadow. Furthermore, he could not touch this thing either. He did not know what this thing was. At the same time, the sound of wind breaking was getting closer and closer. It was mixed with the rumbling of the collapsing building, making it difficult to determine the direction.

Ashes could only set up the diamond ball defense again.

Clang!

A hard object was inserted into the ball shield. Ashes immediately performed a micro maneuver. The moment the ball shield came into contact with the object, a hole opened up and caught the hard object. It was obviously a strike cannon.

Although he could not see, Ember immediately dispelled the other unknown Diamond Shields and turned them into piercing spears, shooting in the direction of the hard object. In his estimation, he should be able to hit Han Xiao, who was holding a weapon.

However, he did not hit anything.

"Not good!"

Ashes immediately reacted, but it was too late. A mech's large hand grabbed the back of his head from behind, and without a word, a Void Jet Spray was shot.

At the same time, Han Xiao also used the leader's Character Summon Card, [Armor Piercing Combo]. The next five seconds of attacks would have a certain armor piercing effect and reduce the target's defense by twenty-four percent.

Boom!

Ashes felt as if he was struck by lightning. His brain buzzed, and he saw stars. His Esper Ability stagnated for a moment.

It was at this moment that the board under his feet collapsed, and the two of them fell together with the collapsing building!

Hualala …

Smoke and dust hit their faces, and the sound of collapsing and whistling echoed in their ears.

Before this, Han Xiao had used the chaotic environment to create a diversion. He used [Void Projection] to block Ashes's vision and threw out melee weapons. He then activated [Void Travel] to silently appear behind Ashes and attack from the back.

This was a rare opportunity. At this moment, Han Xiao would not let go and did not conserve his energy. Void Jet Spray was the Void Dragon mech's attack ability. It did not have a cooldown, but if it was used again within ten seconds, the energy consumption would increase by thirty percent.

"Remaining energy 42% hum … remaining 26% hum … energy almost depleted hum …"

The mech's energy was drained rapidly, and Philip's notification echoed in the mech's helmet.

Ashes hurriedly gathered energy in his body. No matter what profession, energy had a common use, and that was to increase resistance for a short period of time.

After being hit repeatedly, Ashes had no choice but to focus on protecting himself. His control over his Esper ability had decreased by seventy to eighty percent.

Han Xiao had already seen some of Ashes's attributes through the interface. He was also a Boss, so his resistance and HP were both very high. Furthermore, he was an A-Rank Boss, so his HP was not lower than Han Xiao's. Thus, he did not dare to be stingy at this moment. [Gene Liberation], [Overload], and various other explosive skills were used one after another. There was also Hella's Character Summon Card, which could weaken the target's focus to a certain extent.

This series of explosive attacks was extremely fast. The collapse process was only halfway done, and the two of them were still falling weightlessly.

Ashes's head was pressed down. The humiliation and pain made him furious.

Although he could not see behind him, he could feel that Han Xiao's energy waves were weakening. This meant that there was not much energy left in his mechanical suit, so this meant that Han Xiao's outburst was about to end.

Although he had suffered some losses, at least he had achieved his goal. Once he reached the outside world, as long as he could hold on until he landed, this would be his home ground!

The last Void Jet Spray had drained all of the mecha's energy. Ember noticed this and endured the headache, saying hoarsely, "You're out of energy … Just wait for me to drag you out of this tortoise shell and grind you into minced meat!"

Han Xiao heard this and gritted his teeth. "Aroshia!"

Aroshia was not affected by gravity. She had been chasing after the two of them as they fell. Her golden body passed through pieces of building debris, and upon hearing Han Xiao's words, she turned into a stream of light and suddenly accelerated. She stuck close to Han Xiao's back and opened her arms as if she was hugging him from behind.

Hum!

Her energy body melted like liquid and flowed into the mech's energy core.

At this moment, the Void Dragon mech's energy value was instantly filled to the brim!

"Energy remaining: 327% hum … Circuit overload … Please release excess energy as soon as possible hum …"

To him, Aroshia's ability was like a large reserve battery.

Han Xiao tightened his grip and clamped Ashes's head like an iron hoop. The wind tore his voice apart.

"Energy, I have plenty of it! Are you ready for a severe concussion?! "

Boom boom boom!

Feeling the energy surge behind him, Ashes's eyes widened. He was shocked and angry. He finally felt that things were not going well. The situation was out of control.

This feeling … reminded him of all the times he had fought with Han Xiao, and he gritted his teeth in anger.

Every time, every time!

This bastard always had different methods!

The series of explosions drowned out his thoughts. The two of them fell from the sky all the way to the ground. The huge impact made them dizzy. Their bodies were in extreme pain as if their bones were about to fall apart. They could not get up for a while.

At this moment, the shadow on the ground expanded rapidly.

The next second, the collapsed building came crashing down.

Boom!

Smoke and dust billowed!
